name: research_demo
description: DNS research demonstration scene. Two static obstacles plus one obstacle that crosses the route, in the same 10 x 6 m arena as the PPO baseline. This is the scene used for the demonstration recording and for the dynamic-navigation experiment. All coordinates are DNS: +x forward, +y right, fixed altitude, fixed yaw.
_dimension_justification: 10 x 6 m is kept, NOT enlarged to 12 x 8 m. Spencer's policies were trained in planar.py on LOW=[0,-3] HIGH=[10,3], and navigation.observation divides the goal vector by 10 and caps lidar at 5 m. Widening the arena would push the relative-goal feature and the free-space statistics outside the distribution the policies saw, so results would no longer be comparable with the static baseline. A larger arena belongs in a clearly labelled out-of-distribution generalisation study, not in the headline demonstration.

obstacles._comment: Static pillar, offset left of the straight line so the direct route is blocked but a route exists on either side.
Second static pillar, offset the other way, so the drone has to change side at least once.

Crossing obstacle at constant speed. Placed between the two pillars at x=5.1 so it sweeps the corridor the drone must transit. amplitude 1.6 m and speed 0.45 m/s give a period of 4*1.6/0.45 = 14.22 s. At phase 0 it starts at y=-1.6, which is 4.5 m from the start point, so it never overlaps the drone at reset. Closest approach between the mover envelope and either pillar leaves about 0.98 m of free gap, comfortably more than the drone's 0.36 m diameter, so the scene is always navigable.
